coreFeatures.title: Everything you need to ship.
coreFeatures.subtitle: The foundational features of every great SaaS are already built-in, so you can spend your time focusing on your unique agent logic.
coreFeatures.authenticationDesc: Secure login, registration, and magic links powered by Auth.js.
coreFeatures.stripeBillingDesc: Flexible subscription plans with automatic webhook syncing.
coreFeatures.customerPortalDesc: Self-serve billing management, plan upgrades, and invoices.
coreFeatures.teamWorkspacesDesc: Invite members, manage roles, and share resources seamlessly.
coreFeatures.adminDashboardDesc: High-level overview of users, revenue, and system health.
coreFeatures.darkModeDesc: Native light, dark, and system theme support out of the box.
coreFeatures.mdxBlogDesc: SEO-optimized, markdown-powered blog to drive organic traffic.
coreFeatures.emailTemplatesDesc: Beautifully styled, responsive transactional emails via Resend.
coreFeatures.databaseOrmDesc: Type-safe database interactions configured with Prisma or Drizzle.
coreFeatures.rateLimitingDesc: Built-in endpoint protection to prevent abuse and manage load.
coreFeatures.edgeReadyDesc: Optimized for Vercel Edge functions for lightning-fast responses.
coreFeatures.i18nSupportDesc: Full locale support with EN, FR, DE, and ES out of the box. Add more languages with a single JSON file.

bentoFeatures.label: Features
bentoFeatures.title: Everything your team needs to run on autopilot.
bentoFeatures.backgroundWorkflowsDesc: Agents run autonomously in the background — researching, drafting, and executing multi-step tasks while your team sleeps.
bentoFeatures.humanInLoopDesc: Set approval gates on any workflow step. Every critical decision surfaces to your team before the agent proceeds.
bentoFeatures.secureStorageDesc: Every output — documents, images, structured data — is automatically saved and versioned in your secure storage layer.
bentoFeatures.customPersonasDesc: Spin up specialized agents for each function: legal review, competitor analysis, content production, and more.

featureDeepDive.desc1: Provide a high-level goal and watch the AI generate a deterministic, step-by-step execution plan. Workflows run in the background for minutes or hours without timing out, while you watch the agent think and execute live in the chat UI.
featureDeepDive.desc2: Critical steps can be strictly flagged to require human review. Workflows automatically pause and alert you. Approve, reject, or provide feedback directly in the chat window, and the agent instantly resumes.
featureDeepDive.desc3: No more digging through endless chat logs. The system intelligently catches final deliverables as they are created and deposits them into a centralized, searchable vault.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From idea to shipped in three steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Point agents at your tools, docs, and data sources. One-time setup, zero ongoing maintenance.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Agents research, execute, and iterate in the background — adapting to each task without hand-holding.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Review results, approve decisions, and publish outputs. You stay in control of every critical step.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common questions, straight answers.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.securityAnswer: All data is encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256 and TLS 1.3. We do not train on your data. Our infrastructure is hosted on SOC 2 Type II-compliant cloud providers, and we are currently pursuing our own SOC 2 certification.
faq.onboardingAnswer: Most teams are fully up and running in under 30 minutes. Our guided setup walks you through connecting your first data source, configuring your initial agents, and running your first automated workflow — no engineering resources required.
faq.integrationsQuestion: What tools and integrations do you support?
faq.integrationsAnswer: We support REST API and webhook-based integrations out of the box, which means we connect to virtually any modern SaaS tool. Native connectors are available for the most popular platforms, with new integrations added regularly based on customer demand.
faq.cancelAnswer: Yes, there is no lock-in. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your billing settings. Your data remains accessible and exportable for 30 days after cancellation, giving you full control of your information.
faq.trialQuestion: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.trialAnswer: Yes — every account starts with a 14-day free trial with full access to all features, no credit card required. At the end of your trial, you can choose the plan that fits your team's needs or continue on the free tier.
